A '''Neimoidian''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a [[Councillor/Legends|councilor]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was stationed on a Separatist [[Unidentified Separatist asteroid base|asteroid base]] and was involved in the development of a [[Updated battle droid|new model]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]].
